title: KARMOKAR's Latest Single, "Houdini": A Raw Expression of Society and Life
htmlContent:
KARMOKAR, the self-taught singer, songwriter, producer, and engineer has recently released a new single titled "Houdini." The song is a unique blend of his cultural background and the hip-hop he grew up listening to, with a touch of flexing.

The lyrics of "Houdini" reflect KARMOKAR's thoughts on society and his current life. It's an authentic and raw expression of his emotions, and he freestyled the entire song in just a couple of hours. One of his friends made the hard-hitting and original beat of the music, making the creative process a lot of fun for KARMOKAR.

Having grown up in rough Indian slums and various cities in Britain, KARMOKAR believes that his art's ultimate purpose is healing, not just for himself but also for his listeners. He has been influenced by sounds and started using music to release his thoughts and emotions at fifteen.

"Houdini" is a must-listen for anyone who appreciates authentic and raw expressions of emotions through music. KARMOKAR's unique style and perspective are sure to captivate you.
